Fire.name: Fireball
Fire.description: Bright streaks flash from the sky to a point within range and then blossom with a low roar into an explosion of flame.

Fire.name: Flame Smite
Fire.description: A vertical column of divine fire roars down from the heavens in a location unspecified.

Fire.name: Meteor Shower
Fire.description: Fiery meteors rain down from the sky, impacting randomly across the land.

Fire.name: Spontaneous Combustion
Fire.description: An object or creature suddenly bursts into flames without any apparent cause.

Fire.name: Ring of Fire
Fire.description: A circle of fire erupts around a random area, trapping anything inside.

Fire.name: Flaming Geyser
Fire.description: A burst of flame shoots up from the ground unexpectedly.

Ice.name: Sky of Cold
Ice.description: A blast of cold air erupts from the sky.

Ice.name: Ice Storm
Ice.description: A hail of rock-hard ice pounds to the ground in a 20-foot-radius.

Ice.name: Frozen Ground
Ice.description: The ground becomes slick with ice, causing creatures to slip and fall.

Ice.name: Hailstorm
Ice.description: Chunks of ice fall from the sky, pelting everything below.

Ice.name: Frostbite Winds
Ice.description: A chilling wind causes frostbite to those exposed.

Ice.name: Glacial Spike
Ice.description: A massive spike of ice erupts from the ground, impaling anything above it.

Lightning.name: Lightning Strike
Lightning.description: A bolt of lightning descends from the sky, striking a random target.

Lightning.name: Chain Lightning
Lightning.description: Lightning arcs from one target to another, hitting multiple creatures.

Lightning.name: Static Field
Lightning.description: The air becomes charged, shocking anyone who touches metal.

Lightning.name: Ball Lightning
Lightning.description: A sphere of electrical energy moves randomly, shocking anything it contacts.

Earth.name: Earthquake
Earth.description: The ground shakes violently, causing structures to collapse and chasms to open.

Earth.name: Rock Slide
Earth.description: A cascade of rocks tumbles down a slope, crushing anything in its path.

Earth.name: Quicksand
Earth.description: The ground turns to quicksand, trapping creatures that step into it.

Earth.name: Stone Spikes
Earth.description: Sharp rocks erupt from the ground, impaling anything above.

Wind.name: Tornado
Wind.description: A violent tornado forms, sweeping up anything in its path.

Wind.name: Gust of Wind
Wind.description: A strong wind blows, pushing creatures and objects.

Wind.name: Air Blade
Wind.description: A razor-thin blade of air slices through targets.

Wind.name: Whirlwind
Wind.description: A swirling column of air lifts and tosses creatures and objects.

Water.name: Flash Flood
Water.description: A sudden surge of water floods the area.

Water.name: Water Spout
Water.description: A column of water rises and moves, sucking in anything nearby.

Water.name: Acid Rain
Water.description: A toxic rain falls from the sky, damaging creatures and corroding materials.

Water.name: Tidal Wave
Water.description: A massive wave crashes onto the shore, sweeping away everything.

Shadow.name: Darkness Falls
Shadow.description: An unnatural darkness envelops the area.

Shadow.name: Shadow Grasp
Shadow.description: Shadows become solid and entangle creatures.

Shadow.name: Nightmare Visions
Shadow.description: Creatures are tormented by terrifying illusions.

Shadow.name: Eclipse
Shadow.description: The sun is obscured, casting the land into darkness.

Light.name: Blinding Flash
Light.description: A sudden burst of light blinds creatures temporarily.

Light.name: Solar Flare
Light.description: A beam of intense light scorches the area.

Light.name: Healing Rays
Light.description: A soothing light heals wounds and cures ailments.

Light.name: Luminescent Fog
Light.description: A glowing fog fills the area, illuminating hidden things.

Nature.name: Vine Entangle
Nature.description: Vines sprout from the ground, restraining creatures.

Nature.name: Spore Cloud
Nature.description: A cloud of toxic spores envelops the area.

Nature.name: Beast Stampede
Nature.description: A herd of wild animals rushes through, trampling anything in their path.

Nature.name: Pollen Burst
Nature.description: Allergic reactions cause sneezing and distraction.

Chaos.name: Wild Magic Surge
Chaos.description: Unpredictable magical effects occur, causing random outcomes.

Chaos.name: Temporal Distortion
Chaos.description: Time warps in the area, causing delays or hastening.

Divine.name: Angelic Choir
Divine.description: Heavenly music heals and uplifts those who hear it.

Divine.name: Divine Judgement
Divine.description: A beam of divine light smites wrongdoers.

Divine.name: Blessing of Protection
Divine.description: A shield surrounds creatures, reducing incoming damage.

Necrotic.name: Life Drain
Necrotic.description: Life force is siphoned from creatures, weakening them.

Necrotic.name: Deathly Chill
Necrotic.description: A cold aura saps the vitality of those nearby.

Necrotic.name: Ghastly Visage
Necrotic.description: Horrific images cause fear and mental anguish.

Arcane.name: Mana Burst
Arcane.description: A surge of magical energy explodes outward.

Arcane.name: Arcane Lockdown
Arcane.description: Magic becomes unstable or unusable in the area.

Arcane.name: Spell Echo
Arcane.description: Spells cast in the area may repeat unexpectedly.

Poison.name: Toxic Cloud
Poison.description: A poisonous gas fills the area.

Poison.name: Corrosive Rain
Poison.description: An acidic rain falls, damaging creatures and objects.

Poison.name: Noxious Fumes
Poison.description: Inhaled fumes cause sickness and disorientation.

Mind.name: Psychic Scream
Mind.description: A mental assault causes intense pain.

Mind.name: Telekinetic Storm
Mind.description: Objects are hurled around by unseen forces.

Time.name: Time Stop
Time.description: Time freezes for a brief moment.

Metal.name: Magnetic Pull
Metal.description: Metal objects are drawn together forcefully.

Sound.name: Thunderclap
Sound.description: A loud boom damages and deafens creatures.

Sound.name: Echo Chamber
Sound.description: Sounds are amplified, making stealth impossible.

Illusion.name: Mirror Images
Illusion.description: Multiple illusions of creatures appear, causing confusion.

Illusion.name: Displacement
Illusion.description: Perceptions are distorted; objects appear shifted.

Life.name: Bloom
Life.description: Plants grow rapidly, overtaking the area.

Life.name: Rejuvenation
Life.description: Wounds heal and energy is restored.

Death.name: Blight
Death.description: Plants wither and die; creatures are drained of life.

Death.name: Deathly Aura
Death.description: An aura of death harms living creatures.

Death.name: Soul Rend
Death.description: A portion of the soul is torn away.

Space.name: Planar Rift
Space.description: A tear between dimensions releases unknown entities.

Space.name: Gravity Well
Space.description: Creatures are pulled toward a central point.

Space.name: Teleportation Flux
Space.description: Creatures and objects randomly teleport short distances.

Luck.name: Fortune's Favor
Luck.description: Good luck befalls creatures in the area.

Luck.name: Misfortune
Luck.description: Bad luck causes mishaps and accidents.

Luck.name: Random Chance
Luck.description: Unpredictable events occur, for better or worse.

Luck.name: Coin Flip
Luck.description: An outcome is determined by pure chance.

Nonmagical.name: Meteorite Impact
Nonmagical.description: A meteorite crashes into the ground, causing massive destruction.

Nonmagical.name: Avalanche
Nonmagical.description: A massive slide of snow or rock tumbles down a mountain.

Nonmagical.name: Sinkhole
Nonmagical.description: The ground collapses, creating a deep pit.

Nonmagical.name: Wildfire
Nonmagical.description: A fire spreads rapidly, consuming everything in its path.

Nonmagical.name: Stampede
Nonmagical.description: A herd of animals rushes through, trampling anything.

Nonmagical.name: Plague of Insects
Nonmagical.description: A swarm of insects descends, devouring crops and causing chaos.

Nonmagical.name: Flood
Nonmagical.description: Water levels rise, submerging low-lying areas.

Nonmagical.name: Eclipse
Nonmagical.description: The sun or moon is obscured, affecting visibility and moods.

Nonmagical.name: Famine
Nonmagical.description: Crops fail, leading to food shortages.

Nonmagical.name: Drought
Nonmagical.description: A lack of rain causes water sources to dry up.
